verdict.rationale: Microsoft's webhooks-and-connectors docs state that Incoming Webhooks post messages from apps into Teams and connect web services to channels and teams (also framed as posting updates from external services to channels). One older community comment says integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack unlike Slack's simple webhooks, but it gives no concrete failure of incoming webhooks, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: detail on the webhook URL setup flow and payload format, evidence that a plain URL POST is all that's needed, and independent hands-on corroboration.
